analysis:
Examined both BASE documentation excerpts and the bounded change orientation for docs/architecture/inference.md. The change replaces constant-frame-rate-only GLM video admission (BASE lines 810–813, 827) with presentation-order indexing using nominalFrameRate and admits variable-frame-rate tracks. No concrete security regression is established by these documentation excerpts.
Relevant boundaries are A-001, TB-007, T-050 and T-041: media remains described as bounded by a 512 MiB decoded-frame cap and shared prepared-pixel cap (BASE 812–826), excluded from prefix reuse/capture (828–833), and covered by explicit memory reservations. The unchanged surrounding documentation describes retirement-bound resource ownership (934–944, 1043–1050), numeric-only timing telemetry (1174–1178), physical deadline admission and calibration qualification (1280–1437), and target-authoritative, output-budget-limited MTP (1531–1606). None establishes a change to authorization, hop encryption, billing, credential custody or privileged-helper authority.
Integration should verify GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset and GLM5NextVisionBudget.videoTokenCeiling together: indexing VFR frames by average rate must preserve duration/frame/pixel limits and conservative memory reservations even when sample timestamps differ from presentation timestamps. Implementation evidence is absent here, so this is an unverified contract, not an observed missing control. The additional inline-video-label documentation change around HEAD 1896–1899 is only partially present in the patch and outside these primary excerpts; its complete text and corresponding ingestion change remain for integration review.
